known_uncertainty.summary: Review by a qualified employment-law and appellate practitioner remains pending; no independent review is recorded and no level-3 claim is made.
Automated schema, citation, deadline, and replay checks do not establish the legal accuracy, completeness, currency, or practical realism of the cited authorities or authored analysis.

Operation bindings, record tags, and semantic classifications are authored for the exact identified documents and do not generalize to novel filings, altered bytes, or unreviewed procedural circumstances.

The judgment, rehearing, mandate, stay, and shortening occurrences are authored, bound inputs; the system validates their use but does not infer finality or choose triggering events from arbitrary records.
The separately docketed branch pages are counterfactual training artifacts that never occurred on the actual appeal and must remain isolated from actual-history questions and disposition grounding.

The bench profiles and oral-argument behavior are synthetic training constructs; differentiation and deterministic replay do not model any real judge or predict actual advocacy, questioning, or outcomes.

These PDFs are generated training artifacts. Source-to-PDF checks and pinned hashes document repository provenance for the accepted render, but they do not establish external authenticity, cross-render byte determinism, or complete accessibility and typography quality.
